front: How do you fit AR(p) with numpy?
back: Build a matrix with a column of ones and p lag columns. Solve np.linalg.lstsq(X, y[p:]). You lose p rows.

What is a recursive multi-step forecast?
back: Forecast one step, append it to the history, then forecast again. Never use true future values.

front: What does an AR forecast do at long horizons?
back: It tends to the mean mu of the series. The effect of the last values fades.
